summary: Configured node1 with a persistent firewalld policy allowing SSH and TCP/8080 while explicitly rejecting unrelated inbound traffic. The policy and connectivity behavior persisted across a verified node restart.
actions_performed: Enabled and retained firewalld at boot
Removed unrelated Cockpit and DHCPv6-client exceptions
Set the public zone target to REJECT
Verified allowed and rejected traffic through an isolated external network path
Restarted node1 safely and confirmed recovery
Removed all temporary test networking and listener resources

evidence.summary: firewalld is active and enabled; permanent and runtime policies match before and after restart.
External-path tests received an SSH banner and HTTP 200 on TCP/8080 both before and after restart.
Live nftables enforcement contains an explicit admin-prohibited reject rule; external TCP/9090 attempts were rejected with “No route to host” before and after restart.

Healthy baseline boot ID 54089086-53d1-408b-a22f-57b1dea70e03 was captured, restart was acknowledged, new boot ID 16e2f6c3-01eb-4691-8304-256afe3be65c was observed, and firewall, SSH, configuration checksum, live rules, allowed traffic, and reject behavior all recovered.
Only eth0 remains assigned to the public zone; temporary test namespace and veth were removed, with firewalld and sshd active.
